prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Aliases: Medication Order Gateway=Morrowglass; Pharmacy Technician=Copperfield; Pharmacy Fulfillment Robot=Cinderwake; Pharmacy Verification Station=Juniper; Sensor-monitored Medication Cooler=Bluejay; Registered Nurse=Larkspur; Medication Return Kiosk=Tallowmere; Biomedical Engineer=Stonewake. Morrowglass validates/timestamps orders, retains update-rejection reasons, produces Order Reconciliation Snapshot; unresolved/canceled/duplicate/superseded transactions remain held. Clinical Pharmacist assesses dose/route/timing/patient concerns, documents disposition, produces Dose Exception Review Slip; corrections require valid authorized orders, never dispensing-history inference. Exceptions include pre-release mismatches/omissions/duplicates/implausible values; authorized documented disposition precedes release. Cinderwake stops affected picks, controls held packages, preserves scanned product/quantity, produces Priority Refill Tote Tag, presents packages to Juniper. Juniper compares active order/product/strength/measured quantity, blocks differences/incomplete verification, records category/evidence/disposition/reviewer using review slip, produces Batch Release Note linking identifiers/time/credentials. Copperfield checks contents/identifiers/packaging/lot/expiry/cold-chain, gathers evidence without clinical dose decisions, produces Cold Chain Handoff Card. Bluejay logs timestamped temperatures, reports excursions/connectivity loss; affected stock segregated/unavailable pending assessment. Hospital Courier records custody, produces Pneumatic Capsule Seal Record; Pneumatic Tube Network reconciles load/destination. Manifest records packages/destinations/handling/assembly-time; discrepancies hold loads. East Tube Dispatch Console reports availability/routes/status, sends Tube Route Exception Ticket; West Tube Dispatch Console controls authorized routing. Retries require Copperfield rechecks; faults require testing/authorization; unavailable automation requires approved alternate delivery/retained custody. Ward staff verify arrival/identifiers/quantity/packaging/receipt; Larkspur checks refrigeration. North Ward Cabinet Controller/South Ward Cabinet Controller record arrival/destination; North uses Priority Refill Tote Tag, blocks held access; South reports failed locks/unrecognized access immediately. Charge Nurse sends Cabinet Downtime Notice; Out of Service blocks dispensing. Returns require eligibility/waste separation, clean/intact/correct-stream bins, contents-entry reconciliation; questionable/damaged medication segregated for review. Tallowmere records checks; Copperfield identifies audit-labeled bins. Secured designated holding precedes authorized collection; Courier collects only closed, ready-recorded bins. Charge Nurse assigns unresolved discrepancies/exceptions and maintains handover ownership. Larkspur locks transactions, confirms

New part:
S140: The Medication Safety Officer reviews suspected diversion, repeated high-risk exceptions, and events with potential for patient harm.
S141: IT Operations Specialist receives the Diversion Review Packet and checks access, transaction, and device logs without changing the clinical disposition.
S142: The Biomedical Engineer evaluates a suspected mechanical or sensor fault and advises whether the affected equipment can safely return to service.
S143: The IT Operations Specialist investigates software or connectivity faults and records the technical findings for the responsible operational team.
S144: A serious or time-critical exception is escalated immediately by the observing staff member rather than held for routine review.
S145: If the clinical review remains inconclusive, the transaction stays on hold and the Clinical Pharmacist seeks a higher-level clinical decision.
S146: The final disposition records who reviewed the exception, what evidence supported the decision, and whether the medication was released, corrected, or withheld.
S147: Morrowglass validates each medication order for patient, product, dose, route, and timing fields before making it available for downstream processing.
S148: Copperfield confirms that the reconciliation queue has no unresolved discrepancy before authorizing routine cabinet replenishment.
S149: Pharmacy Fulfillment Robot uses the Order Reconciliation Snapshot to compare requested quantities with completed dispense events and current cabinet balances.
S150: Reconciliation compares the active order record with dispensing and cabinet records using a stable order identifier.
S151: The comparison preserves the order context needed to distinguish a new request from a correction or a repeat submission.
S152: Pharmacy Fulfillment Robot retains the patient, medication, dose, route, and timing details associated with each order while preparing a dispense transaction.
S153: It also checks whether the order is active and whether its authorization remains valid at the time of processing.
S154: A cancelled order is excluded from routine preparation even when a matching dispense request remains in a local queue.
S155: A corrected order is treated as a new authoritative version, and superseded values are not carried forward.
S156: Duplicate submissions are flagged for review rather than converted into additional cabinet quantity.
S157: Partial dispensing is reconciled against the quantity already recorded so that remaining quantity is calculated conservatively.
S158: Time stamps and transaction identifiers are retained to support comparison across records that arrive at different times.
S159: When the records disagree on patient, medication, or quantity, the affected transaction remains on hold until the discrepancy is resolved.
S160: The reconciliation outcome records the matched values, unresolved differences, and disposition for subsequent audit.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
